Name: Object Time Left
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: See how much time is left until machines finish processing.
Description:
**Object Time Left** lets you see how much time is left until machines finish processing.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Press [font=Courier New]L[/font] (configurable) to toggle the overlay.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ObjectTimeLeft/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
